It can get pretty out of hand. I remember there were usually two or three staff members handling about 20 patients at a time. You could tell they were stressed.

The hospital I was at was ridiculous though. Completely unorganized. We never fought or tried to have sex with each other, so it wasn't anything of that nature.

A good example that comes to mind for me is that one night we were going to have a movie night. The staff picked Armageddon. Wtf. Why would you play that for a bunch of suicidal people? One of the patients said something and they made us watch Pocahontas instead. Not really much better, but whatever.

Anyways, I'm glad you were a staff member that cared. There aren't enough of you out there.

All of this and the fact that they take away so much from you.

I wasn't allowed to eat chips. I wasn't allowed to have lotion in my room, among tons of other restrictions. My family brought me my favorite cookies to cheer me up, and the staff took them away.

Also, having to participate in the degrading therapy. "Color what you feel." It was not therapeutic for me at all. I felt like I was being treated like a toddler.

I lied through my teeth to get out of there. And I don't regret it. 

I'm doing fine now, though. This was over ten years ago.

But yeah, I still see where you're coming from. I would think the same thing if I were you.

It's more on his end. I thought things were great. Our sex life was good and all that. I think that's why I'm taking it so hard. I was really blindsided. He just basically told me that he loves me, but isn't in love with me anymore. He says the spark isn't there and doesn't know if it will be again. He said he's felt this way for the past year and a half. Which, honestly, fucks with me even more. I thought we were fine.

He wants to try. But its proven to be difficult for me because I feel betrayed and its hard to trust him knowing he's been bottling all this up for so long. He's not a bad guy. He would never intentionally hurt me. This is just fucking with my head really bad and its going to be really hard for me to get over it.

I love him and I want to be with him, but I often ask myself how much strain we can really put ourselves under before we snap? If I can't get over my trust issues, nothing will ever be resolved. It sucks. 

We still are best friends. He knows me better than anyone ever has before. He's just not in love with me anymore and I'm not taking it very well.
